backend_preparation.pin_manifest_budget: Separate 2097152-byte conservative pre-encoder metadata budget for the combined source/runtime pin map. backend_preparation.host_job_refusal: Unchanged refusal of any preexisting supervisor job; no breakaway or implicit compatibility. First failure stage HOST_JOB means the membership query failed; HOST_JOB_MEMBERSHIP identifies nonzero membership; HOST_JOB_DEADLINE identifies the clock/deadline check after zero membership. Membership retains precedence when both predicates would fail. No additional API or native eligibility probe. Historical combined HOST_JOB/VALUE remains ambiguous and is not relabelled.
backend_preparation.failure_diagnostics: First caught supervisor failure only: fixed stage and error-class labels, optional unsigned32 numeric winerror/errno field with its field domain, fixed pin phase and ordinal0..256. Missing diagnostics do not establish success or absence of an error; serialization failure retains a constant emergency output, and output failures remain memory-only without rewriting a partial file. No API trace or native qualification follows from injected diagnostics.
